name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 5 visits over 31 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 31 hours starting 2026-03-28, at wavelengths from 0.85 to 4.61 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
